name: Quiver
author: Quiver
description: Quiver in the bar: its mark, the running game's title, and the download queue as a progress ring (with the percentage or speed), with distinct marks for paused, failed and stalled downloads. The panel has what is playing (Sight, Open in Quiver, Stop), the recently played games to launch, the queue with pause and resume, and a way into Quiver. Follows `quiver playing --follow --json --no-start` (quiverd's events, no polling) and polls `quiver queue --json --no-start` (every 2 s while downloading, every 15 s otherwise); never starts quiverd.

barWidget.description: Quiver's mark, the running game's title and download progress. Click for now playing, recent games and the queue; middle-click opens Quiver.

schema.label: Beside the mark
schema.description: playing: the running game's title, and the percentage while only downloading. percent, speed, both: the download's progress only. none: the mark alone.
